timecoded_text_to_speech.text: As a machine learning model, I do not have feelings or emotions.
I am a computer program that has been trained on a large data set of text to generate human-like responses to various prompts.
I can understand and respond to natural language inputs such as text or speech, but I do not possess consciousness or self-awareness and I do not experience emotions.
My responses are based on patterns and associations and the data that I have been trained on, and not on personal experiences or feelings.

youtube_description:
One of the first questions I did to chatGPT if it has feelings. Sentient machine is a machine capable of “feeling”. What is feeling? Some believes feelings is an old thinking process. Your “gut feeling” may be an old decision process. If feeling is an old thinking process, there is nothing special about feeling. If feeling is the ability to sense the world, just hook up chatGPT with a physical machine, and it will feel!
